Gold and Silver Prices See Slight Decrease on October 6, 2026

On October 6, 2026, gold and silver prices experienced a decrease. Reports indicate that factors such as easing probabilities of an October Fed rate hike, a soft US nonfarm payroll report for September, and robust ETF inflows are supporting gold prices. However, elevated yields and firm oil prices, coupled with a healthy risk appetite, are capping these gains. The coverage includes the latest rates for 24K and 22K gold, as well as 999 silver, across various Indian cities including Delhi, Mumbai, and Chennai.
